6588-types-of-children-s-literature-a-co.title: Collected And Edited
6588-types-of-children-s-literature-a-co.creator: Unknown
6588-types-of-children-s-literature-a-co.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _Types of Children's Literature_ is intended to provide students of the subject with a single-volume anthology of prose and poetry illustrative of the different types, styles, interests, periods, authors, etc., of writings for children. There are, of course, many collections of specimens of children's literature; but they are all made as reading books for children and, consequently, are unsatisfactory, in some important respect or other, as source books.

arxiv-1909-12028.title: Modeling Electromagnetic Navigation Systems for Medical Applications using Random Forests and Artificial Neural Networks
arxiv-1909-12028.creator: Ruoxi Yu, Samuel L. Charreyron, Quentin Boehler, Cameron Weibel, Carmen C. Y. Poon, Bradley J. Nelson
arxiv-1909-12028.description: Abstract Electromagnetic Navigation Systems (eMNS) can be used to control a variety of multiscale devices within the human body for remote surgery. Accurate modeling of the magnetic fields generated by the electromagnets of an eMNS is crucial for the precise control of these devices.

arxiv-2101-01591.title: On the minimum number of high degree curves containing few points
arxiv-2101-01591.creator: Mario Huicochea CONACyT/UAZ
arxiv-2101-01591.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mario Huicochea CONACyT/UAZ. Let d , n ∈ ℤ + d,n\in{\mathbb{Z}^{+}} and A A be a nonempty finite subset of ℝ 2 {\mathbb{R}}^{2} . A curve of degree d d is the zero set of a polynomial of degree d d in ℝ ⁡ [ x , y ] {\mathbb{R}}[x,y] ; denote by 𝒞 d {\mathcal{C}}_{d} the family of curves of degree d d .

arxiv-2212-08025.title: Probing Lepton Number Violation and Majorana Nature of Neutrinos at the LHC
arxiv-2212-08025.creator: K.S. Babu, Rahool K. Barman, Dorival Gonçalves, Ahmed Ismail
arxiv-2212-08025.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by K.S. Babu, Rahool K. Barman, Dorival Gonçalves, Ahmed Ismail. Observation of lepton number ( L L ) violation by two units at colliders would provide evidence for the Majorana nature of neutrinos. We study signals of L L -violation in the context of two popular models of neutrino masses, the type-II seesaw model and the Zee model, wherein small neutrino masses arise at the tree-level and one-loop level, respectively.

arxiv-2302-07798.title: Tunable fiber source of entangled UV-C and infrared photons
arxiv-2302-07798.creator: Santiago Lopez-Huidobro 1 , 2 , ∗ \textrm{Santiago Lopez-Huidobro}^{1,2,^{*}} , Maria V. Chekhova 1 , 2 \textrm{Maria V. Chekhova}^{1,2}
arxiv-2302-07798.description: Abstract Pairs of entangled photons — biphotons — are indispensable in quantum applications. However, some important spectral ranges, like ultraviolet, have been inaccessible to them so far. Here, we use four-wave mixing in a xenon-filled single-ring photonic crystal fiber to generate biphotons with one of the photons in the ultraviolet and its entangled partner in the infrared spectral range.

arxiv-2306-05701.title: CAWL: A Cache-aware Write Performance Model of Linux Systems CCS: Software and its engineering Secondary storage CCS: Computing methodologies Modeling and simulation CCS: Software and its engineering Virtual memory
arxiv-2306-05701.creator: Masoud Gholami, Florian Schintke
arxiv-2306-05701.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Masoud Gholami, Florian Schintke. The performance of data intensive applications is often dominated by their input/output (I/O) operations but the I/O stack of systems is complex and severely depends on system specific settings and hardware components. This situation makes generic performance optimisation challenging and costly for developers as they would have to run their application on a large variety of systems to evaluate their improvements.

arxiv-2307-02792.title: What Should Data Science Education Do with Large Language Models?
arxiv-2307-02792.description: Abstract The rapid advances of large language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT, are revolutionizing data science and statistics. These state-of-the-art tools can streamline complex processes such as data cleaning, model building, interpretation, and report writing. As a result, it reshapes the role of data scientists.

arxiv-2312-16874.title: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces for 6G: Emerging Hardware Architectures, Applications, and Open Challenges Thanks: E. Basar is with the Communications Research and Innovation Laboratory (CoreLab), Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Koç University, Sariyer 34450, Istanbul, Turk
arxiv-2312-16874.creator: Ertugrul Basar, George C. Alexandropoulos
arxiv-2312-16874.description: Abstract Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) are rapidly gaining prominence in the realm of fifth generation (5G)-Advanced, and predominantly, sixth generation (6G) mobile networks, offering a revolutionary approach to optimizing wireless communications. This article delves into the intricate world of the RIS technology, exploring its diverse hardware architectures and the resulting versatile operating modes.

arxiv-2401-05187.title: Decoding of Selective Attention to Speech From Ear-EEG Recordings
arxiv-2401-05187.creator: Mike D. Thornton, Danilo P. Mandic, Tobias Reichenbach
arxiv-2401-05187.description: Abstract Many people with hearing loss struggle to comprehend speech in crowded auditory scenes, even when they are using hearing aids. Future hearing technologies which can identify the focus of a listener’s auditory attention, and selectively amplify that sound alone, could improve the experience that this patient group has with their hearing aids.

arxiv-2402-05034.title: How BERT Speaks Shakespearean English? Evaluating Historical Bias in Contextual Language Models
arxiv-2402-05034.creator: Miriam Cuscito, Alfio Ferrara, Martin Ruskov
arxiv-2402-05034.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore the idea of analysing the historical bias of contextual language models based on BERT by measuring their adequacy with respect to Early Modern (EME) and Modern (ME) English. In our preliminary experiments, we perform fill-in-the-blank tests with 60 masked sentences (20 EME-specific, 20 ME-specific and 20 generic) and three different models (i.e.

arxiv-2406-03256.title: Quantum sensing from gravity as a universal dephasing channel for qubits
arxiv-2406-03256.creator: Alexander V. Balatsky, Pedram Roushan, Joris Schaltegger, Patrick J. Wong
arxiv-2406-03256.description: Abstract We investigate the interaction of a transmon qubit with a classical gravitational field. Exploiting the generic phenomena of the gravitational redshift and Aharonov-Bohm phase, we show that entangled quantum states dephase with a universal rate. The gravitational phase shift is expressed in terms of a quantum computing noise channel.

arxiv-2410-18194.title: ZIP-FIT: Embedding-Free Data Selection via Compression-Based Alignment
arxiv-2410-18194.creator: Elyas Obbad, Iddah Mlauzi, Brando Miranda, Rylan Schaeffer, Kamal Obbad, Suhana Bedi, Sanmi Koyejo
arxiv-2410-18194.description: Abstract Data selection is crucial for optimizing language model (LM) performance on specific tasks, yet most existing methods fail to effectively consider the target task distribution. Current approaches either ignore task-specific requirements entirely or rely on approximations that fail to capture the nuanced patterns needed for tasks like Autoformalization or code generation.

arxiv-2502-03950.title: LR0.FM: Low-Res Benchmark and Improving Robustness for Zero-Shot Classification in Foundation Models
arxiv-2502-03950.creator: Priyank Pathak, Shyam Marjit, Shruti Vyas & Yogesh S Rawat
arxiv-2502-03950.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Priyank Pathak, Shyam Marjit, Shruti Vyas & Yogesh S Rawat. Visual-language foundation Models (FMs) exhibit remarkable zero-shot generalization across diverse tasks, largely attributed to extensive pre-training on large-scale datasets. However, their robustness on low-resolution/pixelated (LR) images, a common challenge in real-world scenarios, remains underexplored. We introduce LR0.FM , a comprehensive benchmark evaluating the impact of low resolution on the zero-shot classification performance of 10 FM(s) across 66 backbones and 15 datasets.

arxiv-2502-14020.title: Where are the marathon Girls?: An Analysis of Female Representation in the Brazilian ICPC Programming Marathons
arxiv-2502-14020.creator: Crishna Irion 1, Luiz Claudio Theodoro 1
arxiv-2502-14020.description: Abstract Education motivated the encouragement of female participation in several areas of science and technology. Programming marathons have grown over the years and are events where programmers compete to solve coding challenges. However, despite scientific evidence that there is no intellectual difference between genders, women’s participation is relatively low.

arxiv-2507-14542.title: Self-Supervised Distillation of Legacy Rule-Based Methods for Enhanced EEG-Based Decision-Making
arxiv-2507-14542.creator: Yipeng Zhang, Yuanyi Ding, Chenda Duan, Atsuro Daida, Hiroki Nariai, Vwani Roychowdhury
arxiv-2507-14542.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yipeng Zhang, Yuanyi Ding, Chenda Duan, Atsuro Daida, Hiroki Nariai, Vwani Roychowdhury. High-frequency oscillations (HFOs) in intracranial Electroencephalography (iEEG) are critical biomarkers for localizing the epileptogenic zone in epilepsy treatment. However, traditional rule-based detectors for HFOs suffer from unsatisfactory precision, producing false positives that require time-consuming manual review. Supervised machine learning approaches have been used to classify the detection results, yet they typically depend on labeled datasets, which are difficult to acquire due to the need for specialized expertise.

arxiv-2512-21401.title: Properties of plactic monoid centralizers
arxiv-2512-21401.creator: Bruce E. Sagan, Chenchen Zhao
arxiv-2512-21401.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bruce E. Sagan, Chenchen Zhao. Let u u be a word over the positive integers ℙ {\mathbb{P}} . C(u)=\{w\mid\text{$uw$ is Knuth equivalent to $wu$}\}.

pmc-10566289.title: Intra-articular autologous conditioned serum and triamcinolone injections in patients with knee osteoarthritis: a controlled, randomized, double-blind study
pmc-10566289.creator: Nemanja Damjanov, Ana Zekovic
pmc-10566289.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveThis study was performed to assess the impact of autologous conditioned serum (ACS) when added to preceding intra-articular glucocorticoid therapy on pain, function, and quality of life outcomes over 24 weeks.MethodsIn this single-center, randomized controlled trial involving 40 patients with advanced knee osteoarthritis (Kellgren–Lawrence grades III and IV), ACS or saline placebo was injected after 40 mg triamcinolone acetonide (TA) intra-articular injection.

pmc-11467583.title: Analysis of environmental and socioeconomic impacts of industrial parks in Ethiopia
pmc-11467583.creator: Gemechis Guteta Jote, Hailu Worku
pmc-11467583.description: To promote sustainable industrialization, Ethiopia began implementing industrial park development in 2015 as a better policy approach. The study sought to investigate the positive and negative economic, social, and environmental impacts of the country's industrial parks with a purposively selected representative sample size. It used an approach with mixed methods of data collection, analysis, and presentation.

pmc-11540600.title: Comparative Genomic Analyses of E. coli ST2178 Strains Originated from Wild Birds in Pakistan
pmc-11540600.creator: Jung Hun Lee, Abdul Rauf Tareen, Nam-Hoon Kim, Chanyeong Jeong, Byeonghyeon Kang, Gwangje Lee, Dae-Wi Kim, Rabaab Zahra, Sang Hee Lee
pmc-11540600.description: The emergence and spread of multidrug-resistance (MDR) pathogenic Escherichia coli due to horizontal gene transfer of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) and virulence factors (VFs) is a global health concern, particularly in developing countries. While numerous studies have focused on major sequence types (STs), the implication of minor STs in ARG dissemination and their pathogenicity remains crucial.

pmc-11626029.title: Development of a Multiplex PCR to Simultaneously Detect Four Problematic Pathogens in Cymbidium kanran
pmc-11626029.creator: Jiwon Kim, Sunyung Yoon, Seungtae Kang, Ho Bang Kim, Kyung-Hwan Boo
pmc-11626029.description: Colletotrichum gloeosporioides (Cg), Pestalotiopsis sp. (Ps), Fusarium oxysporum (Fo), and Fusarium proliferatum (Fp) are pathogens that cause various diseases of Cymbidium kanran. Species identification based on the morphological characteristics of pathogen-infected orchids is very complex and difficult; therefore, specific and reliable diagnostic methods are needed.

pmc-12444064.title: Sex Disparities in Patient Satisfaction in Cardiac Surgery Patients
pmc-12444064.creator: Stefanie Ma, Kavi O’Connor, Sashane John, Xueqi Huang, Nicole Sherman, Pey-Jen Yu
pmc-12444064.description: Although differences between males and females in the diagnosis and management of cardiovascular diseases are well recognized, there is a paucity of studies evaluating the impact of sex on the perception and satisfaction of cardiovascular care. The purpose of this study is to evaluate potential sex-based disparities in patient experiences with their postoperative care after cardiac surgery.

pmc-12551119.title: Clinical Validation of the SECONDs Tool for Evaluating Disorders of Consciousness in Argentina
pmc-12551119.creator: María Julieta Russo, María de la Paz Sampayo, Paula Arias, Vanina García, Yanina Gambero, Mariano Maiarú, Florencia Deschle, Hernán Pavón, Xerxes D Arsiwalla
pmc-12551119.description: Background: The Coma Recovery Scale–Revised (CRS-R) is the gold standard for diagnosing chronic disorders of consciousness (DoC); however, its clinical utility is limited by lengthy administration and the need for specialized training. The Simplified Evaluation of Disorders of Consciousness (SECONDs) provides a faster and more user-friendly alternative.

pmc-12581082.title: Use of beta-blockers and in-hospital mortality in patients with Takotsubo cardiomyopathy: systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12581082.creator: Caroline de Oliveira Fischer Bacca, Beatriz Stephan, Victor Alejandro Gomez, Marcelo Vier Gambetta, Giovanna Cardoso de Moraes, Giulia Lisanti Soares, Marina Machado, Vinh Quang Tri Ho, Luciana Gioli-Pereira
pmc-12581082.description: IntroductionTakotsubo cardiomyopathy (TC) is a stress-induced catecholamine acute myocardial dysfunction in the absence of significant coronary disease. The pathophysiology of TC remains poorly understood, and the use of beta-blockers (β-Blockers) appears promising. However, the impact of β-blockers in acute-phase management remains uncertain.

pmc-13065998.title: Validation of automated 5 mL thin liquid swallowing sound segmentation for estimating audio-derived pharyngeal clearance time
pmc-13065998.creator: Dushyantha Jayatilake, Yohei Teramoto, Tomoyuki Ueno, Koichiro Matsuo, Kenji Suzuki
pmc-13065998.description: This study evaluates the reliability of using automatically segmented audio events to detect pharyngeal swallowing activity by comparing their onset and offset timings with physiological event markers derived from videofluoroscopic swallowing studies (VFSS). Swallowing sounds were recorded from 45 patients with suspected dysphagia during VFSS using a neck-worn electronic stethoscope (NWES).

pmc-13388244.title: Birth outcomes associated with maternal antiglaucoma medication exposure: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13388244.creator: Hanying Fan, Yiji Zhang, Lin Jing, Yu He, Suzhen Wang, Liuzhi Zeng
pmc-13388244.description: BackgroundAntiglaucoma medications are indispensable for preserving maternal vision, yet the associations between their use and adverse birth outcomes remain inconclusive.MethodThe meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 and MOOSE guidelines. We searched Web of Science, PubMed, Embase, and ScienceDirect for eligible comparative studies. The outcomes were low birth weight (LBW), preterm birth (PB) and congenital anomalies (CA).

pmc-13404159.title: Individualized PEEP titration guided by static lung compliance reduces postoperative atelectasis in elderly patients during laparoscopic Trendelenburg surgery: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13404159.creator: Jinze Li, Xuepeng Cao, Liquan Huang, Guojie Han, Xiuqin Wang

pmc-13439458.title: Pre-trained knowledge transfer with application in multisystem inflammatory syndrome subphenotyping in children
pmc-13439458.creator: Xiaokang Liu, Naimin Jing, Yiwen Lu, Jason H Moore, Christopher B Forrest, James Zou, Yong Chen
pmc-13439458.description: Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) is a severe post-acute sequela of SARS-CoV-2 infection in children and presents with highly heterogeneous signs and symptoms. Disentangling the clinical manifestations of MIS-C by characterizing its subphenotypes can help identify children at risk for severe outcomes and may help identify more targeted therapies.

pmc-13458402.title: The Evolutionary History and Morphological Divergence of Corallivorous Fishes on Coral Reefs
pmc-13458402.creator: I Marrable, N Peoples, M A Kolmann, J M Huie, W F Figueira
pmc-13458402.description: SynopsisSpecialized ecological niches can represent evolutionary traps that increase extinction risk when environments change. The consumption of coral tissue, mucus, and skeleton is a rare feeding niche despite the abundance of coral on reefs, which raises questions about the evolutionary consequences of this dietary specialization.

pmc-13481985.title: Development and characterization of a long-acting allosteric growth hormone receptor antagonist for acromegaly
pmc-13481985.creator: Katherine Kurylo, Page R Bouchard, Mark N Milton, Peter F Moesta, Laura E Dichtel, Jesper Gromada, Vyas Ramanan, Thomas Vincent, Melinda Smith, Chew Shun Chang, Jack McGuire, Richard Shimkets, Mark P Joing, Joshua Lehrer-Graiwer, Beryl B Cummings, Ethan J Weiss
